metadata.description: Claude Code mods for agentic development in the void repo: agent panel, context bar, ASCII canvas, color picker, git guard

plugins.name: agent-deck
plugins.description: Live agent panel: model, effort, step, context and current tool per agent, plus task progress

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context meter above the prompt, split per subagent, with cost and rate limits

plugins.name: ascii-canvas
plugins.description: ASCII canvas pane: model sketches, block-letter banners, flow diagrams, style sampler

plugins.name: color-picker
plugins.description: Color pane with formats, nudges, ramp, harmonies, contrast and a palette tool

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Refuses the git operations AGENTS.md forbids for parallel agents
